Something nearby seems to have stopped moving.
For a moment, you feel watched.
The space just over your shoulder feels occupied.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.hostile.1: Something in the distance seems to have woken.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.hostile.2: For one moment, everything is unnaturally quiet.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.hostile.3: A low sound carries from somewhere far away.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.hostile.4: The dark suddenly feels less empty.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.gift.1: What you received may not entirely belong to you.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.gift.2: The gift feels a little heavier than you expected.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.gift.3: Something about the weight in your hand feels borrowed.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.loss.1: You feel as though you have forgotten something.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.loss.2: Your pockets seem a little lighter.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.loss.3: Something familiar is suddenly difficult to remember.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.loss.4: There is an absence you cannot quite place.
The sky seems a shade darker than before.
The sun looks strangely far away.
A long shadow passes without a source.
It feels later than it should be.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.weather.1: The air suddenly smells a little damp.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.weather.2: Very faint thunder rolls in the distance.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.weather.3: The air prickles against your skin.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.weather.4: A wind rises where there was none.
For an instant, you cannot tell where you are.
The ground feels slightly misplaced beneath you.
The horizon does not sit quite where you remember it.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.damage.1: A sudden chill runs through you.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.damage.2: It feels as if something inside you is missing.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.damage.3: Your breath catches for no clear reason.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.damage.4: For a heartbeat, you feel hollow.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.power.1: You feel something in you shift.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.power.2: Everything suddenly seems a little easier.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.power.4: The change fits almost too well.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.reputatio: Nearby faces seem to regard you differently.
A familiar glance lingers too long.
Someone looks away when you notice them.
Your name feels different in other mouths.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.hallucina: Did something just move at the edge of your sight?
For a moment, the world skips.
A shape vanishes when you look directly at it.
You blink, but the afterimage remains.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.world.1: The world seems to have heard.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.world.2: Something settles into place far beneath you.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.world.3: The world gives a small, almost imperceptible shudder.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.world.4: For a moment, everything feels newly arranged.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.general.1: Something has changed, though you cannot say what.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.general.2: The silence afterward lasts a little too long.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.general.3: You have the odd feeling that something noticed.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.general.4: Nothing looks different. That is not reassuring.
omen.wishing_willow.capability.general.5: The moment passes, but not completely.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.hidden.1: Nothing happened. At least, not yet.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.hidden.2: The world offers no answer you can see.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.hidden.3: For now, everything remains exactly where it was.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.hidden.4: Whatever heard you gives no sign.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.delayed.1: The wish seems to be waiting for something.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.delayed.2: The answer has not arrived yet.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.delayed.3: Something has been set aside for later.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.delayed.4: You feel the moment has merely been postponed.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.progressive: This feels like only the beginning.
Something has started moving, very slowly.
The change has not finished with you.
A first step has been taken somewhere.
omen.wishing_willow.delivery.conditional: The wish seems to be waiting for the right moment.
An answer waits behind an unopened door.
For now, one small condition remains unmet.
